2608.05791.title: A Two-Tier Perspective on Inference-Time Parallelism in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
2608.05791.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM)-driven multi-agent systems typically require multiple model invocations and complex coordination during inference, and their execution strategies directly affect system accuracy, latency, and computational cost. Parallel execution provides a means to improve inference-time efficiency. From the perspective of inference-time execution, this paper models parallelism in multi-agent systems as two distinct levels of decision processes: Replica Parallelism, which explores multiple complete solution paths at the task level, and Structural Parallelism, which enables concurrent execution within a single solution path through task decomposition. However, the roles of different forms of parallelism and their interrelationships still lack systematic study in terms of unified organization and coordination. We therefore propose TIPEX, a controllable execution framework that unifies these two levels of parallelism and coordinates their roles within the inference process under a unified execution semantics while supporting systematic combinations and analyses of different parallel strategies and parameter configurations. Systematic experiments on the GAIA benchmark demonstrate that inference-time parallelism can significantly improve accuracy and reduce end-to-end latency at the cost of increased token consumption. Further analysis shows that Replica and Structural Parallelism exhibit complementary effects across task complexities, with tasks of intermediate difficulty benefiting most from their coordination, while overly aggressive parallel strategies do not necessarily yield better performance.
2608.05791.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）驅動的多代理系統在推理過程中通常需要多次模型調用和複雜的協調，其執行策略直接影響系統的準確性、延遲和計算成本。<lb/>平行執行提供了一種提高推理時間效率的方法。<lb/>從推理時間執行的角度來看，本文將多代理系統中的平行性建模為兩個不同層次的決策過程：複製平行性，探索任務層級的多條完整解決路徑，以及結構平行性，通過任務分解實現單一解決路徑內的並行執行。<lb/>然而，不同形式的平行性及其相互關係在統一組織和協調方面仍然缺乏系統性的研究。<lb/>因此，我們提出了TIPEX，一個可控的執行框架，統一這兩個層次的平行性，並在統一的執行語義下協調它們在推理過程中的角色，同時支持不同平行策略和參數配置的系統組合和分析。<lb/>在GAIA基準上的系統實驗表明，推理時間的平行性可以顯著提高準確性並減少端到端延遲，但代價是增加了標記消耗。<lb/>進一步分析顯示，複製平行性和結構平行性在任務複雜性上表現出互補效應，中等難度的任務最能從它們的協調中受益，而過於激進的平行策略不一定會產生更好的性能。
